print("\nHazen Plotting Positions:")

    p = (i - 0.5) / n
    print(f"Rank {i} (value={val:,}): P = ({i} - 0.5) / {n} = {p:.4f}")

# For 85th percentile, we need P >= 0.85
target_p = 0.85

# Find the percentile using interpolation
# Rank position for p: m = p * n + 0.5
rank_85 = target_p * n + 0.5

# Interpolate between ranks
lower_rank = int(np.floor(rank_85))

fraction = rank_85 - lower_rank
